name: font-shard-pruning
title: Prune unused font shards to shrink dist below 15MB
description: Add a build-time fonts:prune step that scans final dist text, keeps only unicode-range shards actually used, removes unused @font-face rules, and updates fonts:audit to verify the pruned set. Target dist <= 15MB without modifying font files or changing rendered typography.
creator: makeinu
